title: defaultGeometrySchema
description: The defaultGeometry schema is used in stores where all arrayBufferView geometry declarations use the same pattern for face and vertex elements. This schema reduces redundancies of arrayBufferView geometry declarations in a store and reuses the geometryAttribute type from featureData. Only valueType and valuesPerElement are required. # Geometry buffer |fieldName|type|description| ----|------------|----| |vertexCount|UINT32|Number of vertices| |featureCount|UINT32|Number of features.| |position|Float32[3*vertex count]|Vertex x,y,z positions.| |normal|Float32[3*vertex count]|Normals x,y,z vectors.| |uv0|Float32[2*vertex count]|Texture coordinates.| |color|UInt8[4*vertex count|RGBA colors. |id|UInt64[feature count]|Feature IDs.| |faceRange|UInt32[2*feature count|Inclusive [range](../1.7/geometryFaceRange.cmn.md) of the mesh triangles belonging to each feature in the featureID array.| |region|UINT16[4*vertex count]|UV [region](../1.7/geometryUVRegion.cmn.md) for repeated textures.|

geometryType.description: Low-level default geometry type. If defined, all geometries in the store are expected to have this type. Must be: `triangles`

topology.description: Declares the topology of embedded geometry attributes. When 'Indexed', the indices must also be declared in the geometry schema ('faces') and precede the vertexAttribute data. Possible values are: `PerAttributeArray`Indexed`: When Indexed, the indices must also be declared in the geometry schema (faces) and precede the vertexAttribute data.

header.description: Defines header fields in the geometry resources of this store that precede the vertex (and index) data.

ordering.description: Defines the ordering of the vertex Attributes.

vertexAttributes.description: Declaration of the attributes per vertex in the geometry, such as position, normals or texture coordinates.

faces.description: Declaration of the indices into vertex attributes that define faces in the geometry, such as position, normals or texture coordinates.

featureAttributeOrder.description: Provides the order of the keys in featureAttributes, if present.

featureAttributes.description: Declaration of the attributes per feature in the geometry, such as feature ID or face range.
